{{ _("Examples") }}
{{ landing_examples.yolo|safe }}

{{ _("Real-time person tracking") }}

{{ _("The on-board YOLOv8 model is a single-class person detector — int8 quantised and shipped in ROM.") }}

{{ _("Loaded from /rom/yolov8n_192.tflite — no SD card or download needed.")|safe }}
{{ _("Runs in real time on NPU-equipped boards — the OpenMV N6 and AE3.") }}
{{ _('Bring your own YOLOv8 model trained on Roboflow and load it the same way.')|safe }}
{{ landing_examples.apriltag|safe }}

{{ _("Locate and identify AprilTags") }}

{{ _("AprilTags are 2D fiducial markers — robust to motion blur and partial occlusion, and they give you full 3D pose.") }}

{{ _("Built-in detector — no model file or training needed.") }}
{{ _("Returns ID plus full 6-DoF pose — x/y/z translation and x/y/z rotation.")|safe }}
{{ _("Use for robotics calibration, AR markers, and indoor positioning.") }}
{{ landing_examples.blazeface|safe }}

{{ _("Detect faces with BlazeFace") }}

{{ _("Google's BlazeFace is a lightweight TensorFlow Lite face detector that returns bounding boxes plus six landmarks per face.") }}

{{ _("Loaded from /rom/blazeface_front_128.tflite — pre-quantised, no download needed.")|safe }}
{{ _("Six keypoints per face: eyes, nose, mouth, and ears.") }}
{{ _("No privacy concerns — frames never leave the camera.") }}
{{ landing_examples.qrcode|safe }}

{{ _("Scan QR codes from a live feed") }}

{{ _("The built-in QR decoder handles tilted, distorted, and partially occluded codes.") }}

{{ _("Each result also exposes version, ECC level, and corner coordinates.") }}
{{ _("Numeric, alphanumeric, binary, and Kanji data modes.") }}
{{ _("Returns the decoded payload as a Python string — ready to use.") }}
{{ landing_examples.color|safe }}

{{ _("Find blobs of color") }}

{{ _("find_blobs returns connected pixel regions matching one or more LAB thresholds.")|safe }}

{{ _("Tune thresholds for your lighting — disable auto-gain and auto-whitebal first.") }}
{{ _("Pass multiple thresholds for multi-color tracking in one call.") }}
{{ _("pixels_threshold filters tiny detections; merge=True joins overlapping blobs.")|safe }}
{{ landing_examples.barcode|safe }}

{{ _("Read 1D barcodes") }}

{{ _("Find 1D barcodes anywhere in the frame and decode their payloads.") }}

{{ _('Powered by the ZBar library — recognises EAN, UPC, Code 39/93/128, Codabar, ITF, ISBN, and DataBar.')|safe }}
{{ _("Use a windowed strip in grayscale for the fastest linear scan.") }}
{{ _("Each result has format, payload, rotation, corners, and a bounding rect.") }}
{{ landing_examples.hand|safe }}

{{ _("Track 21 hand keypoints") }}

{{ _("Google's MediaPipe Hand Landmarks model places 21 joints on each detected hand — wrist, knuckles, and fingertips.") }}

{{ _("Loaded from /rom/hand_landmarks_full_224.tflite — running standalone here, without palm detection upstream.")|safe }}
{{ _("Returns one list per hand — index 0 is left, index 1 is right.") }}
{{ _("ml.utils.draw_skeleton draws all 21 joints and connections in one call.")|safe }}
